description:
phi_tuple (types/emptiness.rs:60-85) builds, for each coordinate i of each negation, a Vec<Descr> of intersections for coordinates before i and a difference for i, then a Vec<&Descr> for the split. Chains through descr.rs:653-661 (Descr::intersect / diff) from emptiness.rs:75-77: dnf.rs:61 about 4,200, finite_set about 1,600, plus conj/descr clones.

Change, each proven to give the same answer over the existing emptiness tests before it replaces anything: the meets for coordinates before i are built incrementally (coordinate j's meet is the same for every i > j, so it is computed once per negation, not once per i); a coordinate whose meet or cut is empty answers without the recursive call. Interning is not involved (these are descriptors, not ids), but the tuple_emptiness_steps counter is pinned at 17 in types_test: a fall is lowered and listed, a rise is a stop.

Evidence: census of the OptionParser probe at c0e52fbaf (tip of #518; 734,597 allocations): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/c0e52fbaf_top.txt; call chains: cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census && python3 chain.py c0e52fbaf.pkl <file:line> <depth> "" <n>; line numbers are exact at commit c0e52fbaf.
